items: AI chatbots let multi-location brands answer guests around the clock without staffing every location at all hours.
Chatbots work best for FAQs about hours, menus and bookings, order and delivery status, and routing complex issues to the right person.
Keep people on emotional recovery, nuanced multi-step problems and high-stakes conversations with VIPs or frustrated guests, and make sure the bot hands off smoothly.
For multi-location brands, chatbots bring consistent answers to every location, channel and hour while easing pressure on frontline staff.
